name: Staff — complaints queue lists reports and filters by status

planSteps.description: The page heading reads "Complaints" and the subtitle reads "Triage and resolve resident environmental complaints"
A table is shown whose header row includes the columns Tracking, Type, Barangay and Status
At least one row is listed, and its Tracking cell matches the pattern CMP-YYYY-NNNNN
Every row now visible shows the status Pending; no row shows Resolved or Rejected
The summary line below the table reads "Showing N of M" where N is the number of visible rows

description: A CENRO staff member opening the complaints queue sees the resident complaints listed with their tracking references, and narrowing the status filter to Pending leaves only Pending rows and an updated result count.
